title: Samaṇabrāhmaṇā (2)
text: 1 Sāvatthi || || 2 Ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā va brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañcanissaraṇañca yāthābhūtaṃ napajānanti || || Evam kātabbam || || 3 Ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā lābhasakkārasilokassa samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānanti || sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharantīti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
